newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE-Salt Lake City, Utah, $15 mln TRANs.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE-Salt Lake City, Utah, $15 mln TRANs.

text.p: Sealed bids for the purchase of $15,000,000 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes, Series 1997 of Salt Lake City, Salt Lake County, Utah, will be received up to 10:00 A.M., M.D.T., on

at the office of First Security Bank, National Association, the Financial Advisor to the City, at its address indicated below. The Notes will be dated July 1, 1997, issuable in fully registered, book-entry only form, in denominations of

$100,000 or any integral multiple thereof. The Notes will mature on June 30, 1998. Interest will be payable at maturity at a rate not exceeding five percent (5.00%) per annum to be fixed at the time the Notes are sold. Copies of the PRELIMINARY OFFICIAL STATEMENT, the OFFICIAL NOTICE OF SALE and the OFFICIAL BID FORM and other related information with respect to the Notes, which are being offered subject to the approval as to legality of Chapman and Cutler, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor to the City, First Security Bank, National Association, 41 East 100 South, Suite 300, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, telephone: (801) 246-5598, FAX: (801) 246-5973.
SALT LAKE CITY, SALT LAKE COUNTY, UTAH
